dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: What movies do you like, Nam?
dialogue.reading: ˈwʌt ˈmuːviz duː juː ˈlaɪk, ˈnɑːm?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I love comedies. Last week, I saw such a funny comedy!
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈlʌv ˈkɑːmədiz. ˈlæst ˈwiːk, aɪ ˈsɔː ˈsʌtʃ ə ˈfʌni ˈkɑːmədi!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: I like comedies, too. But I can't watch horror movies. I get scared.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈlaɪk ˈkɑːmədiz, ˈtuː. bʌt aɪ ˈkænt ˈwɑːtʃ ˈhɔːrər ˌmuːviz. aɪ ˈɡɛt ˈskɛrd.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Me neither! Fah loves them, but I never watch them.
dialogue.reading: ˈmiː ˈniːðər! ˈfɑː ˈlʌvz ðɛm, bʌt aɪ ˈnɛvər ˈwɑːtʃ ðɛm.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Sometimes. Last month, I saw such an interesting documentary about Thai food.
dialogue.reading: ˈsʌmtaɪmz. ˈlæst ˈmʌnθ, aɪ ˈsɔː ˈsʌtʃ ən ˈɪntrəstɪŋ ˌdɑːkjəˈmɛntəri əˈbaʊt ˈtaɪ ˈfuːd.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: I usually watch dramas and romantic movies.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈjuːʒuəli ˈwɑːtʃ ˈdrɑːməz ənd roʊˈmæntɪk ˈmuːviz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Romantic dramas? They're such sad movies!
dialogue.reading: roʊˈmæntɪk ˈdrɑːməz? ðɛr ˈsʌtʃ ˈsæd ˈmuːviz!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: I know! I always cry, but I love them.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈnoʊ! aɪ ˈɔːlweɪz ˈkraɪ, bʌt aɪ ˈlʌv ðɛm.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Let's watch a comedy tonight, then!
dialogue.reading: ˈlɛts ˈwɑːtʃ ə ˈkɑːmədi təˈnaɪt, ˈðɛn!
